comments: Review: right-facing source is mirrored to original left-facing enemy bank. Missing standing damage variants use cached damage over reviewed idle; prone/seated poses remain proposals.
Only existing states are wired. All source rectangles and SHA-256 are retained.
Registration correction: centre each complete crop horizontally and keep one shared actor scale/feet baseline; alpha-foot averages were biased by extended boots, splashes and detached specks.
geometry: Same rule Danger family as keeper, independent of body size; feet/contact checks in Lane::step_at. Preserve visible local-knight contour at overlaps.
mapping_basis: Visual review of source sheet and measured components, 2026-10-15; supplemental poses retained separately.
